audit.report: A month-end close batch job (inventory_month_end_close, pid 106255) blocked checkout for 76.8 seconds, dropping success to 27% and putting $13,493/min of revenue at risk. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the idle blocker, but the Continuity Guardian required change-calendar evidence, which revealed an active change (CHG-4410) with a consult_owner policy. Both guardians agreed the trade-off favored termination (waiting would cost ~$808,700 vs. a 95-minute replay), but Invariant I3 forced escalation to finance-ops for owner consultation. No protected settlements were in flight, and the blocker had been idle in transaction for 4 seconds with no progress. The incident ended in escalation with no automatic action executed.
audit.root_cause: The inventory_month_end_close batch job (pid 106255) held locks idle in transaction for 4+ seconds, blocking checkout and causing a 73% success-rate drop.
lessons: Pre-load change-calendar status for inventory_month_end_close into the guardian context so the consult_owner policy (CHG-4410) is known before Round 1, avoiding a wasted revision cycle.
Add a pre-approved termination rule for inventory_month_end_close when checkout success falls below 50% for >30s, bypassing the consult_owner gate during critical revenue windows.
Instrument batch_replayable_month_end_close workers to emit heartbeat/progress metrics so idle-in-transaction stalls are detected and auto-terminated before they block checkout.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian acted on correct evidence but missed the change-calendar invariant in Round 1, forcing a revision; the Continuity Guardian correctly enforced I2/I3 but did not pre-fetch the calendar, adding a round. Both guardians aligned on the trade-off math (BIZ-4) and correctly escalated when policy required owner consultation.
follow_ups: Finance-ops to confirm whether inventory_month_end_close can be terminated during CHG-4410 and document the decision for future automation.
Update the workload registry for inventory_month_end_close with a pre-approved termination threshold (e.g., checkout <50% for 30s) to avoid escalation latency.
Deploy idle-in-transaction monitoring with auto-kill for batch_replayable_month_end_close workers exceeding 5s idle while holding locks.
